notes.title: Royalty Free-For-All is LIVE NOW on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173796/46de58351c21199f1b714d206143cc730f33ef9a.png"][/img][/h1][h1]
[url="http://www.royaltyfreefor-all.com" style="button"]ROYALTY FREE-FOR-ALL IS LIVE ON KICKSTARTER!![/url][/h1][p][/p][p]You heard that right—Royalty Free-For-All is on Kickstarter! Click the button above to find the campaign page.[/p][p][/p][p]Backers can receive incredible rewards like early playtest access, behind-the-scenes art books with developer commentary, and the highest of donations can even introduce [b]new bonus fighters to the game![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="QG0S1AWJlzQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The campaign seeks to improve online modes, visual polish, and fund console ports! But stretch goals expand the game's content in phenomenal ways, including [b][u]Arcade Mode[/u][/b], guest music by [b][u]David Wise, Grant Kirkhope, and Evelyn Lark[/u][/b][i], and new fighters like....[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]There's an unbelievable amount of content inside the Kickstarter page — be sure to [u][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aaaagames/royalty-free-for-all-a-hand-drawn-public-domain-smashup/description"]check it out right here[/url][/u]![/h1]
